integrity.computational_checks: Exact rational absorbing-chain comparisons on 330 nonabsorbing state/parameter cases and 294 direct edge-defect instances.
integrity.result: Analytical theorem with explicit bounded-submartingale proof and exact occupation-defect identity.
integrity.review_scope: Scientific correctness, prior-literature implication and value assessed together; independent validation not performed.

scientific_limitations: Equal incident-weight condition is essential to the proof and is not removed.
The result concerns whole-hyperedge broadcasting at fixed two-type fitness, not arbitrary hypergraph evolution or payoff-dependent games.
No claim to an exact closed form for fixation on an arbitrary hypergraph or to an independent priority audit.
title: Universal Moran suppression under balanced group broadcasts
